purpose: Convert an already-captured forge/provider observation into one canonical AXIOM project event plus one non-authoritative provider observation without deriving durable project identity, actor identity, or governance authority from the provider.
core_invariants: Provider IDs and locators are provenance only; the canonical AXIOM project-object ID must be supplied independently of the provider.
A provider account is not an AXIOM actor unless a separate actor binding has already been verified.
Unsupported provider semantics must be reported explicitly rather than silently discarded.
Provider authenticity evidence is observation evidence, not governance authority.
Adaptation performs no network access and no provider mutation.
claim_boundary: This contract does not fetch from GitHub, Forgejo, GitLab, Radicle, or another provider.
This contract does not verify provider API signatures or transport authenticity; it binds caller-supplied evidence facts.
This contract does not discover or mint canonical project-object IDs from provider IDs.
This contract does not persist the adapted event; M1 Grid retention is separate.
This contract does not restore or mutate provider state.
